evals.prompt: Turn these 25 findings from our website review into a report for our developer, plus a CSV for Jira. The security ones must stay confidential.
evals.expected_output: Should apply the severity scale (Critical/High/Medium/Low), the finding template with all fields, area-prefixed IDs, separate improvements from defects, keep security findings in a separate section or file and out of the general CSV, produce a UTF-8 CSV with RFC 4180 quoting that parses back, and include summary, what works, and not-tested sections. Should mark assumptions and certainty.
assertions: Includes all template fields per finding
Keeps security findings separate and out of the general CSV
Produces a CSV that parses back
Includes what works well and not tested sections
Labels certainty as observed or inferred
Keeps the summary within ten lines
